desk-asana can show each task's key, such as an Asana ID field's `JKD-1630`, in the task list, find a task by it and hand it to Claude.

- New desk-asana setting `asanaKeyField`: the name of the Asana custom field that holds each task's key (several names separated by commas). Empty by default, which keeps the pane as before with titles only
- With it set, the `/desk-asana` list shows the key dimmed after each task's title, in My tasks, search results and project tasks
- Typing a key such as `JKD-1630` in the search box finds that open task and lists it first, next to the usual text search
- `Hand to Claude` puts the key in front of the task's title

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`. Set the key field with `/plugin configure desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod`.
